name: Linkychecker
description: Checks links in content for broken/dead URLs.
project_description:
Provides link checking functionality for link entities .

 Linkychecker checks and records the status of Linky entities (Managed Links). Status is available for viewing on an individual basis and as Views fields.

 By default, links are checked on creation, and re-checked on an interval. Links can also be checked on demand.

 Versioning 

 
 2.0 Drupal 8, 9, 10, deprecated.
Sites using version 1.x can switch to 2.x without any issues as it is internally compatible 
 2.1 Drupal 9 minimum 
 2.2 Drupal 10 minimum
